contract: GET /api/sessions/open. Admin open-session snapshot preserves owning-user/device/playback fields without leaking data to listeners; concurrent sync/list must be safe.
exceptions: Mapping only: no tests executed in this invocation. Historical evidence is retained for provenance and does not verify this checkout; named tests are assertion leads, not exhaustive proof of every stated requirement.

invariants.contract: GET /api/sessions/open as an admin answers {sessions, shareSessions}: each open session in creation order is its toJSON plus user {id, username}, shareSessions is [] with no open share, a session entry reflects each sync and disappears once closed, and a non-admin gets 404 while an unauthenticated caller gets 401.
exceptions: Assertion leads only; missing normal/error/edge and state-transition proof must be supplied by the owning packet.
